{{Top|leg}}
'''Kalara Opense''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] who operated out of [[Vergesso Base]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. She [[Pilot/Legends|piloted]] the modified [[Light freighter/Legends|light freighter]] ''[[C Plus]]''.

Despite considered beautiful by aesthetic standards, Opense was a harsh character, and so dedicated to her business of fast deliveries, that she had no friends or outside life.
